name: Magram Alliance
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them.  We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

If you choose to ally with the Magram then slay their foes, the Gelkis.  This will earn you respect among the Magram.  When you earn enough, then meet with the Magram spokesman Warug, on the outskirts of the Magram Village, in southeast Desolace.
narrative.objectives: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The Gelkis cry when they hear your name, adventurer. They fear you and they hate you. They hate you like they hate the Magram!

Maybe you are strong like the Magram. We will see...
narrative.requestItemsText:
Leave! The Magram do not speak with the weak. We kill them!

If you want to speak with me, then show me you are strong. Return after you slay many Gelkis.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 33 to 42, 12,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Magram Alliance
quests.objectiveText: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.

quests.name: Broken Tears

quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring an Advanced Target Dummy to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Khan Shaka
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Khan Hratha
